section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: The directory is `docs/v1/requirements-directory.csv`, outside `docs/tasks/` so that the write guard allows it and so that it survives this effort's archive.

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Plain CSV with one fixed header row and one row per source item: `id,title,source,status,target,effort,spec,note`

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Identifiers are derived mechanically and never invented: `SRC-4.12` journey, `SRC-RULE-5.10` rule, `SRC-2.1.4` capability, `SRC-8.8.9` signal, `DEC-13` decision, `MAP-014` bullet, `MAP-C07` constraint

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: `status` is one of five: `kept`, `superseded`, `duplicate`, `refused`, `deferred`

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: `target` carries the replacing or canonical identifier for `superseded` and `duplicate`

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: `effort` names the child effort that owes the row

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: `spec` names the specification section that satisfies it

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: `refused` and `deferred` carry their reason in `note`

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Rule 1: no identifier appears twice

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Rule 2: every `superseded` or `duplicate` row names a `target` that exists

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Rule 3: every `kept` row names an `effort` that exists as a child effort, and that effort's map lists the identifier in its `## Requirements` section

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Rule 4: every `kept` row names a `spec` section that exists, and every specification section's `Covers:` line lists identifiers that exist and are `kept`

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: A new planning task, `requirements-directory`, runs before the spec: it walks every source, fills the dispositions, and assigns each `kept` row to a child effort from the settled effort list

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: The directory is built separately from `to-spec` on purpose: the completeness checklist must not be built by the author of the thing it checks

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Rules 1, 2 and the effort assignment are checked the moment the CSV exists, and the building task is not done until its own self-check passes them

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Rules 3 and 4 need the specification, so they belong to `to-spec`

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: `to-spec` writes the draft with a `Covers:` line in every section, runs the coverage check against the CSV, and does not publish until the check passes

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: The same `to-spec` run hands the draft to one agent that wrote none of the documents, asked only for contradictions and gaps, with the source set as its input

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Each consistency finding is either fixed or accepted in writing before publication

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Consistency axes are a finite, written-down list: estimate/remaining, deadline/effective date, notice, session leave/stop times, capacity/target/balance, identifier, run mode/authority, change cursor

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Each child effort's map carries a `## Requirements` section listing the identifier ranges it owes, written at creation from the CSV's `effort` column

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: Each child's own finalize review checks its list row by row

section: Notes > Settled: a CSV directory, five dispositions, two checks
title: This effort verifies only what it can: that every requirement was handed to a child that owes it
